intent: Rebuild the Edu_core Parent PWA around a single principle: Zero-Clutter, High-Intent. The home screen is a chronological, event-driven feed where a UI component exists ONLY when a real data condition or deadline makes it relevant. A fee payment card appears days before a due date and disappears the moment the account is in good standing. A bus-tracking card exists only during commute windows. An absence alert exists only on the day the child was marked absent. Everything else stays out of the parent's way. The feed is sorted by time-of-day relevance and urgency, styled with the emotional design language (people, colors, chronology, motion), and backed by a server-side trigger engine that turns routine school data into active UI events. This prompt is written for an AI coding agent continuing the Edu_core implementation after the AMS UI/UX spec v1.2 (phases 1-9 landed on main; phases 10-11 of that plan are PAUSED and resume later exactly as written there). REVISION 1.1 STATUS: spec v1.0 phases P1-P8 are IMPLEMENTED, VERIFIED, and merged on main (commits 0ae4c6ce through 59e2cd4a, released v11.4.0-v11.11.0), and the paused AMS phases 10-11 have since landed too (commits 4ce09d1e, a6c1e8b9). This revision does three things: (1) it fixes nine verified snapshot-assembly defects that starve the pure feed engine of data; (2) it upgrades the parent app from a one-way notification feed to a full two-way operating surface (leave requests, PTM slot booking, fee queries, document submission, notice acknowledgment, bus boarding events, multi-ward operations) with complete business logic; (3) it locks the role-to-role and database relationship contracts behind every operation.

verified_behaviors: deriveParentFeed is a true pure function honoring the zero-clutter invariant: empty snapshot yields zero cards, every card has render conditions, tier, priority, and expiresAt TTL, with morning/evening choreography sorting.

verified_defects: D1 PAYMENT SUCCESS DEAD PATH: the engine's PaymentCard success branch reads inv.lastPayment, but dashboard/page.tsx never maps lastPayment into InvoiceSnapshot, so the payment-success card can never render from real data. The 2h success state is spec-required.

D2 HOMEWORK PENDING DEAD PATH: dashboard builds HomeworkSnapshot only from assignmentSubmissions of the last 14 days with isSubmitted hardcoded true, so pending homework due within 48h (the primary HomeworkCard trigger) can never fire, and subjectName is hardcoded 'Academics'. The snapshot must be built from assignments for the student's class joined LEFT with their submission.

D3 BUS ETA STARVED: dashboard maps busPass with stopOrder hardcoded 1 and fetches no routeStops, no stopName, no stopCoords; computeBusTracking receives an empty stop list, degrading stops-away/ETA to fallbacks.

D4 REPORT CARD VIEW TRACKING MISSING: ReportCardCard is spec-required to disappear once viewed, but nothing writes a viewedAt timestamp and the snapshot never sets previousAverageScore, so scoreDelta is always null and the card persists the full 7 days.

D5 PINNED NOTICES DROPPED: the dashboard query filters notices by publishedAt >= now-72h at the SQL level, so an older isPinned notice (which the engine explicitly supports) never reaches the snapshot.

D6 MESSAGE CARD GUESSWORK: unread teacher messages render teacherName as hardcoded 'Class Teacher' with limit 1 and threadId from parentMessageId; threads are not modeled as student+teacher conversations.
D7 ADMIN PREVIEW OVER-READS: for ADMIN/PRINCIPAL preview the page decrypts names of the first 5 arbitrary active students instead of requiring an explicit ?studentId= preview target.
D8 INVOICE TERM LABEL: invoiceSnaps uses invoiceNumber as termName ('School Term' fallback), so payment cards read like ledger entries, not term fees; map to the fee term name.
D9 NIGHT STALENESS MISSING: the spec's night choreography (frozen feed with staleness note) is not implemented in ParentFeedContainer.

current_state_audit: PARENT APP IS A STATIC MENU APP: (parent)/parent ships dashboard, attendance, bus, documents, fees, profile as separate routes behind static navigation. A parent must know where to look; the app never comes to them. Every transactional feature is always visible regardless of state (fee link is always in the nav even when nothing is due).

PWA SHELL ALREADY EXISTS: manifest.json declares standalone display, theme #1e40af, maskable icons. sw.js is privacy-hardened: it NEVER caches authenticated HTML navigations (network-only with /offline fallback), cache-first only for immutable /_next/static assets, and network-first-with-cache-fallback ONLY for /api/admit-cards/, /api/exams/datesheet, /api/report-cards/. Preserve every one of these rules verbatim.

PUSH INFRASTRUCTURE ALREADY EXISTS: userPushSubscriptions stores endpoint/p256dh/auth per user, pushNotificationLogs logs title/body/status, attendanceNotifications already routes attendance alerts to parentUserId over channel SMS/PUSH/EMAIL. The plumbing exists; what is missing is an event model that decides what to send, when, and with what priority.

FEES DATA MODEL IS ALREADY RICH: feeInvoices carries status (PENDING/PARTIAL/PAID/OVERDUE/WAIVED/CANCELLED), dueDate, netAmount, paidAmount, balanceAmount, lateFeeAmount, and reminderSentD7/D15/D30 flags. paymentGatewayLogs tracks Razorpay order lifecycle (CREATED, ATTEMPTED, PAID, FAILED, REFUNDED). feeInvoices has dueDate and status indexes. Everything needed to drive a conditional payment card already exists.

ATTENDANCE ALERTING PARTIALLY EXISTS: studentAttendance has status enum (PRESENT, ABSENT, LATE, HALF_DAY, LEAVE, HOLIDAY) and smsNotificationSent flags. There is no parent-facing in-app presentation of today's attendance beyond a route page.

TRANSPORT HAS GPS BUT NO ETA ENGINE: gpsPings stores vehicle lat/long/speed per ping; routeStops has gpsLatitude/gpsLongitude, stopOrder, and estimatedArrivalTime ('07:30'); studentBusPasses links student to route + stop with qrCodeData and isActive. There is no boarding/alighting event table yet (flag: do not invent one; bus tracking works from gpsPings + stopOrder proximity).

COMMUNICATION MODULE EXISTS: notices (audienceType PARENTS/CLASS/SECTION, isPinned, publishedAt, expiresAt, DOMPurify-sanitised content), events (eventType: HOLIDAY, EXAM, PTM, SPORTS, CULTURAL with startDate), parentTeacherMessages (moderated threads, isRead, DPDP audit trail). None of this reaches the parent home screen as a feed.

REPORT CARDS AND ADMIT CARDS ARE PARENT-ACCESSIBLE via (parent)/portal/report-cards and (parent)/portal/admit-cards with offline caching already in sw.js. examinations schema has markEntries and reportCards.
DPDP PORTAL EXISTS at (parent)/portal with consent and rights routes: parents manage consent and data rights there. The feed must deep-link into it, never duplicate it.

gaps_and_decisions: No boarding scan table exists. analytics_layer.philosophy: Explainable rule-based signals computed server-side, never client-side, never third-party, never a black box. Every number a parent sees must be traceable to a simple rule the school can defend. No ML dependencies; threshold logic lives in pure functions with unit tests.

trigger_engine.service: backend/src/lib/parentEventEngine/: pure function deriveParentFeed(studentId, now, dataSnapshot) -> FeedCard[] plus BullMQ jobs to persist derived card states in parentFeedCards (studentId, cardType, tier, payload jsonb, activatedAt, expiresAt, dismissedAt).
trigger_engine.promotion_rule: A data point becomes an ACTIVE UI EVENT only when: (a) a deadline is inside its window, (b) a state transition just happened, or (c) an analytics rule fired. Everything else stays queryable behind the child's profile, invisible on the feed.
trigger_engine.card_ttl: Every card has expiresAt: bus cards at commute window end, attendance cards at 20:00 same day, fee cards at payment confirmation (+2h so the success state can render), notice cards at 72h or expiresAt, insight cards at 7 days unless the rule still fires.

analytics_layer.privacy: Signals are computed per student inside schoolId scope. Nothing is persisted that is not already lawfully held; parentNotificationPreferences is the only new personal data. DPDP consent flows in (parent)/portal are untouched; InsightCards respect the same consent posture (aggregate status, no raw data export).

event_driven_ui.home_contract: The dashboard route becomes a single feed: server component derives card states, client FeedCard components render them with react-query polling per card tier (Tier 1: 60s, Tier 2: 10min, Tier 3: on-demand after action). Zero cards is a VALID state: it renders a calm Today strip and the child's identity header only, never placeholder clutter.

micro_progress_catalog.states: Scheduled -> En route -> N stops away -> Arrived at stop -> Departed -> Completed
Initiating -> Processing (Razorpay ATTEMPTED) -> Paid (PAID) -> Receipt ready
Exams done -> Being graded (all examSchedules past, marks not yet published) -> Published -> Opened

tone_laws: Celebration is earned and brief: ReportCardCard gets the only gradient in the app; keep it under 8s of visual festivity (shimmer + emerald), then it becomes a normal card.
Alerts are calm and specific: 'Aarav was marked Absent today at 09:12' beats 'Attendance alert!'. Rose border only for same-day facts; amber for forward-looking risk.
Money is never shameful: PaymentCard copy is neutral and factual ('Term 2 fee of Rs 12,500 is due in 3 days'), overdue adds only the late-fee fact. Never 'defaulter' in parent-facing copy.
Chronology grounds trust: every card shows relative time ('2h ago', 'Due tomorrow'); the Today strip always shows the date and weekday first.
People over data: child's avatar + first name everywhere (AMS law L12 applies); teacher messages show teacher avatars.
emotional_ux.language: next-intl keys for every string: en + hi. Card titles use sentence case, verbs first where an action exists ('Pay Term 2 fee', 'Open report card').

operations_and_workflows.principle: v1.0 made the parent app a read-and-pay surface. v1.1 completes it: every routine parent-school interaction becomes a tracked workflow with states, an owner on the school side, and a card + notification at each state transition. Every workflow follows the same shape: parent action -> persisted request -> school-side actor action -> state machine transition -> parent feed card + tiered notification -> record visible in history.

catalog.name: Pay fee (full or partial)
catalog.v11_extension: Partial payment with explicit allocation order; receipt PDF download; refund status visibility; see business_logic_rules.fees for the allocation and late-fee display rules.

catalog.name: Raise a fee query to the school
catalog.workflow: Parent taps 'Question this fee' on the fee breakdown -> creates feeQuery (studentId, invoiceId, category BREAKDOWN/LATE_FEE/WAIVER_REQUEST/DOUBLE_PAYMENT, message) -> status OPEN -> accountant/school admin answers (public reply stored) -> ANSWERED -> parent confirms or escalates -> RESOLVED or ESCALATED.
catalog.states: OPEN -> ANSWERED -> RESOLVED | ESCALATED (auto after 7 days unanswered, routes to principal), all states timestamped.
catalog.sla: 48h first response, visible on the card ('Typical response: 2 days').
catalog.cards: FeeQueryCard on state changes, T2; ESCALATED is T1 for the principal, not the parent.

catalog.name: Apply for student leave
catalog.workflow: Parent applies from feed card or child profile -> leaveRequest (studentId, type CASUAL/SICK/EMERGENCY/OTHER, startDate, endDate, reason, optional attachment) -> class teacher approves/rejects with note -> APPROVED leaves suppress the day-of absence T1 push and render on the attendance calendar as planned leave -> REJECTED shows the teacher's reason and the normal absence flow applies.
catalog.states: PENDING -> APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED_BY_PARENT (allowed until start of the school day).
catalog.rules: Max 2 overlapping requests per student blocked; teacher sees requests in their approval queue with 1-tap approve/reject; auto-reminder to teacher after 24h pending; approved leave writes a studentAttendance LEAVE row automatically on the leave dates (or marks pre-approved so the daily marking skips the absence alert).
catalog.cards: LeaveApprovedCard / LeaveRejectedCard (T2), LeavePendingCard on the teacher's side.

catalog.name: Book a PTM slot
catalog.workflow: School admin publishes PTM event + slot inventory (per class-teacher, 10-minute slots, capacity 1 parent each) -> PTMCard gains 'Book a slot' once slots publish -> parent picks a free slot -> booking confirms -> reminder at T-1d (T2) and T-2h (T1) -> parent can cancel/reschedule until T-12h -> after meeting, teacher marks HELD with optional note.
catalog.states: PUBLISHED -> BOOKED -> HELD | CANCELLED (slot returns to inventory on cancel).
catalog.rules: One active booking per parent per PTM event; one slot per student per event (sibling case: separate bookings allowed, adjacent slots suggested by the booking UI); booking window opens T-7d, closes T-12h; conflicts resolve with optimistic locking on slot version.

catalog.name: Request bus stop change
catalog.workflow: Parent requests from bus surface (new stopId from routeStops of the same route, reason) -> transport-manager approves/rejects -> on approval the studentBusPass routeStopId updates with an effectiveDate -> old stop remains active until effective date.

catalog.name: Submit and track documents
catalog.workflow: School requests a document type (birth certificate, transfer certificate, address proof, caste certificate, medical form; some with expiry like yearly address proof) -> DocumentRequestCard on parent feed -> parent uploads (S3 presigned, size/type validated) -> school admin verifies -> VERIFIED (acknowledgment card) or REJECTED (reason, re-upload allowed).
catalog.states: REQUESTED -> SUBMITTED -> VERIFIED | REJECTED; expired documents re-enter REQUESTED automatically.
catalog.rules: Reuse the existing documents/CASTE_CERTIFICATE document-type registry; DPDP: documents are PII, stored encrypted per existing pattern, only verification status and type are non-PII.

catalog.name: Acknowledge important notices
catalog.workflow: Notices flagged requiresAcknowledgment render an 'I have read this' action -> acknowledgment stored per parentUser -> unacknowledged parents get a T1 reminder at 24h and 48h -> admin report shows per-notice acknowledgment percentage with a drill-down to non-acknowledged parents (message them in one tap).
catalog.rules: Acknowledgment is per parent user, not per student; sibling households acknowledge once.

catalog.name: Parent-teacher messaging threads
catalog.v11_extension: Model threads as (studentId, teacherUserId, channel CLASS_CHAT) conversations instead of the current flat rows: thread view groups parentMessageId chains; teacher identity resolved from users (fixes D6); unread counts per thread; parent may only open threads with the class teacher or subject teachers of the student's current class-subject mappings (RBAC rule, not UI convention); admin moderation queue keeps existing isModerated audit.
catalog.rules: Threads are read-only for archived students; message content DOMPurify-sanitized on write (existing pattern); DPDP audit trail preserved.

catalog.name: Boarding and alighting scans
catalog.workflow: Driver scans the student's existing qrCodeData at boarding and alighting (scan page in the driver app) -> busBoardingEvents row -> parent gets T2 'Aarav boarded the bus at 07:42' / 'alighted at 16:05' -> cross-check: boarded but daily attendance ABSENT triggers a T1 'Boarded the bus but marked absent - please contact the class teacher' and an admin flag; pass active but not boarded by stop ETA + 15 minutes triggers T1 no-show alert.
catalog.v10_deferred_rationale_resolved: v1.0 forbade inventing a boarding table because no scan producer existed; the driver app surface now ships (driver route group exists), so the table is justified in v1.1.

catalog.name: Request profile and demographics changes
catalog.workflow: Parent edits address (via shared AddressAutofill), phone (OTP re-verify), or demographics (PersonalDemographicsPicker) -> change lands as a PENDING_CHANGE with old/new values -> school admin verifies -> applied on approval; until then the old value renders with a 'change pending' chip.
catalog.rules: PII fields (address lines, phone) require verification before persisting; non-PII (state/district/pincode plaintext columns) apply immediately per the AMS v1.2 schema contract.

catalog.name: Granular DPDP consent
catalog.v11_extension: Per-purpose consent list (fees records, transport tracking, photos in school media, medical data) with grant/withdraw per purpose, consent history log, and a ConsentCard that aggregates multiple pending purposes into one card with a checklist (not one card per purpose). Deep-links into the existing portal consent routes; never duplicates its logic.

catalog.name: Sibling and multi-ward operations
catalog.workflow: Child switcher exists; v1.1 adds: merged Today feed across wards (cards carry ward chips when the same card type fires for two children), combined payment (pay two siblings' invoices in one Razorpay order while keeping per-invoice receipts and allocation), one consolidated notification when the same event kind fires for both wards within 30 minutes ('Both buses are on the way').
catalog.rules: Sibling linkage uses the existing pre-computed sibling detection (landed s13-l7); notifications dedupe key extends to (parentUserId, eventKind, calendarDay) when the merged variant dispatches.

fees.invoice_lifecycle: DRAFT -> ISSUED (publishedAt set) -> PARTIAL (paidAmount > 0, balance > 0) -> PAID (balance 0) with OVERDUE derived at dueDate + graceDays (school config, default 7) while unpaid; WAIVED and CANCELLED are terminal admin actions with reason and audit.
fees.late_fee: lateFeeAmount accrues once at dueDate + graceDays per school config; displayed separately from balance, never silently added: total payable = balance + late fee.
fees.allocation_order: A payment allocates to late fee first, then the oldest outstanding invoice, then the next; partial payments never split a single allocation across invoices when one can be cleared.
fees.reminders: D7 (due in 7 days, T2 card, no push), D15 (overdue 8 days, T1 push if cap allows), D30 (overdue 23 days, T1 push + fee query CTA); reminder flags already exist on feeInvoices (reminderSentD7/D15/D30) and the tier router reads them.
fees.idempotency: Razorpay order creation is idempotent per invoice attempt window via the existing idempotencyKey; paymentGatewayLogs remains the single lifecycle source (CREATED/ATTEMPTED/PAID/FAILED/REFUNDED).
fees.refund_visibility: REFUNDED renders a T3 card with amount and timeline; refunds are initiated school-side only.

attendance.cutoff: Daily marking cutoff per school config (default 10:00 local); PRESENT/LATE never render a card, only the quiet Today strip line.
attendance.corrections: Teacher amends an already-marked status -> parent receives a correction notification ('Updated: Aarav was marked Present after all') referencing the original card, T2; the original T1 push is never retracted.
attendance.leave_preapproval: An APPROVED leave covering today converts the would-be absence into a quiet planned-leave line; the absence T1 push fires only if no approved leave exists at marking time.
attendance.no_show_crosscheck: Boarded bus but marked ABSENT -> T1 parent push + admin flag (OP9).

homework.lifecycle: ASSIGNED -> SUBMITTED (on time) | LATE (submitted after due) -> CHECKED (grade published); MISSING derived after due + 24h with no submission.
homework.card_triggers: Pending due within 48h (T2, priority 75 if due tomorrow); graded within 24h (T2); MISSING feeds the homework_neglect analytics signal (2+ in 14 days).

bus.commute_windows: Weekday 06:30-08:30 and 14:00-17:30 local, school-configurable; outside windows the live map never renders (schedule view instead), already enforced in P5.
bus.approaching_threshold: T1 'approaching' push at 2 stops away OR ETA <= 10 minutes, deduped once per commute window per direction.
bus.boarding: Scan events are T2; the missed-boarding alert (active pass, no boarding by student-stop ETA + 15 minutes) is T1.
bus.eta_engine: Existing computeBusTracking (haversine + stopOrder) stays the single source; routeStops must always be fetched by every caller (fixes D3).

ptm.slot_inventory: 10-minute slots, teacher capacity 1 parent each, generated per teacher per PTM event by the admin publisher.
ptm.windows: Booking opens T-7d, closes T-12h; cancel/reschedule until T-12h frees the slot instantly.
ptm.conflict_rules: One active booking per parent per event; optimistic-lock slot reservation (version column) so two parents cannot take the same slot.

notifications_v11.new_event_kinds: FEE_QUERY_ANSWERED (T2), FEE_QUERY_ESCALATED (T1 principal), LEAVE_DECIDED (T2), LEAVE_PENDING_24H (T2 teacher-side), PTM_SLOT_CONFIRMED (T2), PTM_TOMORROW (T2), PTM_IN_2H (T1), PTM_CANCELLED (T3), STOP_CHANGE_DECIDED (T2), DOCUMENT_VERIFIED (T3), DOCUMENT_REJECTED (T2), NOTICE_ACK_REMINDER_24H/48H (T1), BOARDING/ALIGHTING (T2), MISSED_BOARDING (T1), ABSENT_BUT_BOARDED (T1), PROFILE_CHANGE_VERIFIED (T3), CONSENT_REMINDER (T1 at deadline-48h, already in P7).
notifications_v11.daily_cap_evolution: Cap stays 3 T1/day/parent; merged sibling events consume one slot; morning-queued pushes from quiet hours dispatch in priority order.
notifications_v11.weekly_digest: Monday 08:00 local T2-only digest card summarizing last week per ward: attendance days, homework graded count, fees status, upcoming PTM/exams; replaces nothing, adds one card.

analytics_v11.cohort_percentile: Report card screen shows subject-wise class average vs student (aggregate, never ranks or other students' identities), computed from existing markEntries aggregation.
analytics_v11.sibling_aware_risk: attendance_risk and homework_neglect computed per student as in v1.0; the digest merges the wards' signals for the parent without cross-student data exposure.
analytics_v11.explainability: Every InsightCard payload keeps model + finding + the rule inputs (e.g. '3 of last 10 school days'); no scores without rule inputs visible in the payload.

database_relationship_map.migration_policy: Every new table ships as a numbered drizzle migration registered in the journal exactly like migration 0043 (commit 095359f2); the entity-engine schema catalog (commit 52892d54) must be updated so omnibox/NER sees the new entities; factory_reset.ts must truncate the new tables (P1 already follows this pattern).

Child IdentityHeader: avatar, name, class-section, attendance sparkline chip, sticky on scroll.

acceptance_criteria: AC-P1: ZERO-CLUTTER RULE VERIFIED: with all invoices paid, no bus pass, attendance PRESENT, and no notices, the home feed renders only the Today strip and child header. Grep the feed page: no card renders unconditionally.
AC-P2: PaymentCard renders for a PENDING invoice inside 7 days of dueDate, for PARTIAL, and for OVERDUE; it does not render for PAID/WAIVED/CANCELLED.
AC-P3: BusLiveCard renders only within the configured commute window on a school day with an active studentBusPass; outside the window the bus page shows the schedule, never a live map.
AC-P4: T1 pushes respect the 3/day cap, dedupe key, and 21:30-07:00 quiet hours; unit tests cover the limiter.
AC-P5: deriveParentFeed is a pure function with unit tests covering every card type's render/hide conditions and TTLs.
AC-P6: All strings resolve through next-intl in en and hi; switching language flips every card including micro-progress.
AC-P7: sw.js privacy rules unchanged byte-for-byte except any explicitly commented additions; authenticated HTML is never cached.
AC-P8: Report card and admit card deep links work offline after first view (existing sw cache rules).
AC-P9: Analytics signals are pure functions with unit tests: attendance_risk, performance_dip, fee_stress, homework_neglect.
AC-P10: Dark mode complete on every card; every color used comes from the existing semantic palette; the ReportCardCard gradient is the only gradient.
AC-P11: No new npm dependencies; pnpm-lock.yaml unchanged.
AC-P12: All click budgets in this spec verified manually and listed in the PR description.

AC-P13: All defects D1-D9 fixed with regression tests: payment success card renders within 2h of a real PAID payment; pending homework due tomorrow renders; bus card shows real stops-away with fetched routeStops; report card card disappears after first view and shows real score deltas; pinned old notices reach the feed; message cards show real teacher names; admin preview requires explicit studentId; invoice term name maps to the fee term; night staleness note renders.
AC-P14: Every new workflow table has a numbered migration registered in the drizzle journal, appears in the entity-engine schema catalog, and is truncated by factory_reset.ts.
AC-P15: All new event kinds route through the existing notificationMatrix tier router with dedupe keys and caps; no component dispatches push directly.
AC-P16: Leave approval suppresses the day-of absence T1 push (integration test).
AC-P17: PTM slot booking is race-safe under two concurrent bookings (optimistic lock test); one active booking per parent per event enforced.
AC-P18: Fee query auto-escalates to principal after 7 days unanswered (worker test).
AC-P19: Boarding scans are append-only and drivers can never read student PII beyond name and QR payload (RLS test).
AC-P20: Notice acknowledgment report shows correct percentage and the bulk remind action creates T1 notifications respecting caps and quiet hours.
AC-P21: Multi-ward: merged feed renders ward chips; combined payment produces one Razorpay order with per-invoice receipts and correct allocation order.
AC-P22: Every new server action runs inside withTenant RLS with schoolId scoping; no query bypasses tenant context (follows commits eda51ef0, c460e975, 1a02486f).
AC-P23: Weekly digest card renders Monday 08:00 with correct per-ward aggregates; all card strings bilingual.
AC-P24: Click budgets: apply for leave 4 clicks, book a PTM slot 3, raise a fee query 3, upload a requested document 3, acknowledge a notice 1.
constraints: Do not alter tenant isolation, RBAC checks, DPDP consent flows, or the fees/exam lock logic.
Do not implement AMS plan phases 10-11 (paused); import shared components that exist on main, and leave clean seams (imports, props) where the paused phases will land theirs.
Reuse the razorpay actions in (parent)/portal; one payment path only.
No third-party analytics SDK, no ML library, no geofencing service, no new realtime transport.
Never persist derived feed cards beyond their TTL; the feed is derived state, not a second source of truth.
Parent-facing copy never uses the words defaulter, risk score, or churn; insights state facts.
implementation_order: Phase P1-P8: DONE, verified, merged (see as_built_verification). Do not redo.

No new features in this phase.

Phase P10 LEAVE REQUESTS: student_leave_requests migration + schema catalog registration + RBAC server actions + engine cards (LeaveApprovedCard/LeaveRejectedCard) + teacher approval queue (surface_p7) + attendance suppression logic (AC-P16) + worker auto-reminder.
Phase P11 PTM BOOKING: ptm_events/ptm_slots/ptm_bookings migrations + admin slot publisher + parent booking flow on PTMCard + optimistic lock (AC-P17) + reminder event kinds + teacher slot view.

Phase P12 FEE QUERIES + PAYMENT COMPLETIONS: fee_queries migration + accountant inbox (surface_p8) + fee query cards + SLA worker + escalation (AC-P18) + partial payment allocation order + receipt PDF download + combined sibling payment (OP12).
Phase P13 NOTICES + DIGEST: notice_acknowledgments migration + acknowledgment action + admin report with bulk remind (AC-P20) + weekly digest worker and card (AC-P23).

Phase P14 BUS BOARDING: bus_boarding_events migration + driver scan action (append-only, PII-minimal, AC-P19) + boarding/alighting cards + no-show and absent-but-boarded cross-checks + stop_change_requests flow.

Phase P15 DOCUMENTS + PROFILE + CONSENT: student_document_requests + profile_change_requests migrations + parent submission flows + admin verification queues + expiry-driven re-requests + aggregated consent checklist card.

Phase P16 INTEGRATION: multi-ward merged feed with ward chips + workflows hub (surface_p6) + weekly digest + full notification kind wiring through the matrix + acceptance pass AC-P13..AC-P24 + dark mode and bilingual sweep + PR description listing every AC and click budget.
definition_of_done: The parent app has no idle state and no clutter: the home feed contains exactly what today's data says matters, every card can explain when asked why it exists, money and alerts speak calmly, the bus and the report card and the payment all track like an order being fulfilled, and a parent with nothing pending sees a serene screen that says the school has everything under control. Beyond watching, the parent can now transact the full relationship with the school from one surface: request leave, book a PTM slot, question a fee, submit a document, change a stop, acknowledge a notice, and track every request to a decision, with each workflow owned by a named school-side role, every state transition notified per tier, every table migrated and cataloged, and every action running inside tenant-scoped RLS.

usage: docs/parent-pwa-spec.json already exists in the repo (commit 0ae4c6ce). UPDATE that file with this v1.1 content as the FIRST commit of this track, then implement; do not create a second spec file.
Start with Phase P9 (defect fixes) alone; the nine defects starve the existing engine of data and every later phase depends on trustworthy snapshots.
One phase per agent task, in order; each phase is a standalone task boundary with tests and commits, same convention as the v1.0 run.

Every new table follows the migration policy in database_relationship_map: numbered drizzle migration, journal registration (pattern of commit 095359f2), entity-engine schema catalog update, factory_reset truncation.

Every new notification goes through notificationMatrix.evaluateNotificationEligibility; tier assignment for new kinds is in business_logic_rules.notifications_v11; never dispatch push from a component.
Before editing any file, read it fully; head is now 63bd1e4d (v11.16.0) and RLS enforcement landed after the v1.0 audit, so re-verify anchors.
Security constraints (RBAC, tenant isolation with withTenant, DPDP, PII encryption, sw.js privacy rules, driver PII minimization) always win over any spec conflict; log the conflict in task notes.
